fields.FIR_Description: As per the preliminary report recorded on 2025-09-22, a series of small debits adding up to Rs. 50,000 appeared in the statement of the complainant without any authorisation. The time of the incident was given as 11:15 on 2025-09-13. The complainant, Tamilselvi Devi, provided the contact number 9000000452. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complaint mentions Rakesh Gopal, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000405, in connection with the events. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100002. The complaint refers to another person whose identity could not be established. Items referenced in the complaint: digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Multiple small transfers reportedly made in quick succession.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, receiving account, digital document, mobile number, morning, suspect, shopping complex
